## Quick Introduction

Abdul Basit Shahid is a Full-Stack Developer and Backend Engineer from Lahore, Pakistan. He is currently pursuing a Bachelor of Software Engineering at COMSATS University Islamabad, Lahore Campus (Spring 2025 batch). He specializes in designing and building scalable backend systems, full-stack web applications, and developer tools using modern technologies including Laravel, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, React, and Electron.js.

Abdul Basit is passionate about Data Structures & Algorithms, Object-Oriented Design, and Software Architecture. He is open to specialized backend engineering, full-stack development, and system development roles worldwide — both remote and on-site.

## Featured Projects

### FastFood Invoice System
A full-stack Laravel-based invoice management system for fast-food restaurants. Features role-based access control, guest profiles, OTP-less login, Docker deployment, and a complete order billing workflow. Demonstrates expertise in Laravel, PHP, database design, and containerized deployment.
- Tech: PHP / Laravel / Docker
- Repository: https://github.com/basit-shahid/fastfood-invoice-system

### Drop
A minimal, blazing-fast drag-and-drop file utility built for developers. Features instant file transfers, glowing drop zones, multi-format support, and a clean dark UI designed for productive workflows. Built with modern Electron.js patterns.
- Tech: Electron / JavaScript
- Repository: https://github.com/basit-shahid/drop

### TurboDM
A high-performance, professional-grade Download Manager built for Windows. Features a sleek, neon-inspired UI and a powerful multi-threaded core capable of accelerating downloads with up to 32 parallel connections. Demonstrates advanced Node.js stream handling and concurrent I/O.
- Tech: Electron / Node.js
- Repository: https://github.com/basit-shahid/turbodm
